title: CWP/27964/2025 of ARPIT DHIMAN AND ANOTHER Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 121 CWP-27964-2025 Date of Decision: 25.09.2025 ARPIT DHIMAN AND ANOTHER ...Petitioners Vs. STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS. …Respondents CORAM:- HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JAGMOHAN BANSAL Present:- Ms. Shruti Jain Goyal, Advocate with Ms. Varsha Choudhary, Advocate for the petitioners Mr. Ashok Kumar Khubbar, Addl. A.G, Haryana JAGMOHAN BANSAL, J. (ORAL)

1. The petitioners through instant petition under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India are seeking directions to respondent to consider objections submitted with regard to joint tentative seniority list circulated vide memo dated 07.10.2024 (Annexure P-8)

2. Learned State counsel at the outset submits that objections of the petitioners would be considered and addressed within one month.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners agrees to the aforesaid statement.

4. In the wake of statements of both sides, the instant petition stands disposed of.

5. Pending application(s), if any, stands disposed of. (JAGMOHAN BANSAL) JUDGE September 25, 2025 Deepak DPA
